_note: SL · 3rd grade · gymnastics, cheer, dance and singing mixed at random. Third grade multiplies and divides within 144 and meets fractions as numbers (Florida MA.3.AR / MA.3.FR), but has no algebraic notation yet — so tap-the-answer, with genuinely third-grade arithmetic rather than easier numbers.
name: Smart Squad Math
tagline: Math, but make it a performance. Pick your act! ⭐
howToPlay: Read the story, then tap the answer you think is right. Get it wrong and we'll help you try again. Stuck? Tap Need a tip?
levelPickerSubtitle: Level 1 = warm-up. Level 5 = the big finish! 🏆
footerNote: ✨ No sign-up, no passwords — just you, the numbers, and the spotlight.

levels.name: Tumbling Rows
levels.tagline: Groups of the same size. That's multiplying!
levels.cheer: The gymnastics team lines up in 4 rows. There are 6 gymnasts in every row. 🤸
levels.question: How many gymnasts altogether?
hints: 4 rows of 6 means 4 sixes added up.

levels.name: Dance Lines
levels.cheer: 24 dancers need to split into 4 equal lines for the routine. 💃
levels.question: How many dancers in each line?

levels.name: Song Practice
levels.cheer: The choir practises 7 songs. They sing each one 8 times before the show. 🎤
levels.question: How many times do they sing altogether?
hints: 7 × 8 is the same as 7 × 4 twice: 28 and 28.

levels.name: Share the Ribbons
levels.cheer: There are 12 spirit ribbons. One quarter of them are gold. 🎀
levels.question: How many ribbons are gold?
hints: One quarter means splitting into 4 equal groups.

levels.name: The Big Finish
levels.cheer: 5 cheer squads arrive with 9 girls each. Then 7 more girls turn up late. 📣
levels.question: How many girls are there now?
hints: Do the squads first: 5 lots of 9.
